items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a message sent while Claude was running a tool disappearing from the conversation after a window reload

items.ko: [VSCode] 플러그인·MCP 서버 대화상자의 키보드 접근 불가 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Manage Plugins enable toggle and MCP servers dialog rows being unreachable from the keyboard

items.ko: [VSCode] `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 변경 후 로그인 상태가 갱신 안 되던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-ins and sign-outs made in a terminal not showing until a reload after `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` changed in the Environment Variables setting

items.ko: [VSCode] 채팅 Edit diff 가 아래쪽에서 잘리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Edit diffs in the chat being cut off at the bottom at some panel widths and for long wrapped lines; diff boxes now fit the rows shown

items.ko: [VSCode] 설정 동시 쓰기로 `settings.json` 이 깨지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed overlapping settings writes from the extension leaving `~/.claude/settings.json` unparseable or dropping a setting

items.ko: [VSCode] 새 탭 열기 후 입력창에 포커스가 없던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Open in New Tab (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Esc) sometimes leaving the new tab's message box unfocused, so typing went nowhere until you clicked it

items.ko: [VSCode] 닫은 탭 재열기 시 편집기 레이아웃이 분할되던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed reopening a closed Claude tab splitting the editor layout when its locked group still holds another Claude tab and a file

items.ko: [VSCode] 새 세션이 잠긴 편집기 그룹을 또 만들던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed New session opening another locked editor group whenever a file tab shared the group with your Claude tab

items.ko: [VSCode] 세션 검색 중 세션 이름이 좌우로 밀리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed session names shifting sideways in the session picker while typing a search query

items.ko: [VSCode] 플랜 리뷰 카드의 전송 버튼·사유 입력이 잘리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the plan review card cutting off its Send feedback button and reason field when a plan has several comments; the comment list now scrolls

items.ko: [VSCode] 고대비 테마에서 코드 블록이 읽히지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed inline code and code blocks in chat replies being unreadable under the High Contrast themes

items.ko: [VSCode] 스크린 리더의 대화 탐색 개선
items.en: [VSCode] Improved screen reader navigation of the conversation: each message is announced as "You" or "Claude", with the tool name for tool steps

items.ko: [VSCode] 기본 전역 gitignore 경로를 `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/ignore` 로 변경
items.en: [VSCode] Changed the default global gitignore file to `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/ignore` when `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is an absolute path

items.ko: [웹] 클라우드 세션 diff 에 비교 대상 브랜치 선택기 추가
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a "Compare against" branch picker to a cloud session's diff view, so you can diff its changes against any branch instead of only the base branch

items.ko: [웹] GitHub 토큰 갱신 오류로 git 작업이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed git operations in cloud sessions failing with "service unavailable" when GitHub's token renewal briefly errors

items.ko: [웹] 루틴 수정 시 두 번 실행되거나 다시 켜지던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed editing a routine occasionally making it fire twice or re-enabling a routine that had just been paused

items.ko: [웹] 자격증명 갱신 직후 커밋이 서명 오류로 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed commits in cloud sessions occasionally failing with a signing error for a few minutes after the session's credentials refreshed

items.ko: [웹] 루틴 트리거 연결 실패 토스트에 원인 표시
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed the toast after saving a routine whose GitHub trigger couldn't be linked to show the reason, such as a per-repository trigger limit, instead of only "edit to retry"

items.ko: [웹] 읽음 처리한 세션이 다시 안 읽음으로 돌아가던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed sessions sometimes flipping back to unread right after you mark them read

items.ko: [웹] GitHub 연결이 없을 때 루틴을 끄지 않고 72시간 재시도하도록 변경
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed routines to skip a run and retry for up to 72 hours when the owner's GitHub connection is missing, instead of switching the routine off at the first failed check

items.ko: [웹] 구독 일시정지 시 루틴 재개 안내 문구 변경
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed a routine's on-hold notice: when your subscription is paused it now tells you to turn the routine back on yourself instead of promising an automatic resume

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 채널·워크스페이스 추가 폼에 Guests 설정 추가
items.en: [Claude Tag] Added a Guests setting to the Add channel and Add workspace forms in Claude Tag admin settings, so owners can pick Inherit, Allow, Channel only or Restrict up front

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 다른 Slack 앱의 멘션에 응답하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude not answering when another Slack app or bot @mentions it; the tag now gets a reply and wakes Claude in a channel it had stopped following after days of inactivity

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 새 채널 생성 직후 앱 멘션이 누락되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude missing another app's message that tagged @claude right after a new Slack channel was created; it's now delivered once Claude has joined

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 뒤늦은 후속 메시지가 이전 메시지에 병합되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude folding a follow-up sent minutes after its last Slack message into it as a silent edit; late updates such as blockers now post as a new reply that notifies

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 단일 채널 내 Slack 검색이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's Slack search failing with an error whenever it searched within a single channel; it now returns that channel's matching messages

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 안전 필터 중단이 스레드 맥락을 조용히 초기화하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a safety-filter stop silently resetting a Slack thread's context when nobody was waiting; Claude now always says so and no longer cancels background work still running

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 이메일 주소에 `mailto:` 접두어가 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed email addresses in Claude's Slack replies rendering with a visible `mailto:` prefix; they now show as the plain, clickable address

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 그리드 전체 공유 채널 감시를 거부하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to watch an Enterprise Grid channel shared with the whole organization when asked from another workspace in the grid

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 환경 선택기에 이름 대신 환경 ID 가 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the Environment picker in Claude Tag admin settings showing a raw environment ID instead of the environment's name for archived or app-created environments

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Slack 진행 체크리스트의 길이·재게시 주기 제한
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's live progress checklist in Slack: capped at 2,000 characters, reposted at most every 15 minutes in busy threads, with older "Latest task list" links updated

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 캔버스 편집마다 붙던 게스트 표기 메모 제거
items.en: [Claude Tag] Removed the repeated guest-attribution note Claude appended to a Slack canvas each time it edited one in a channel using the "Channel only" guest setting

items.ko: [Code Review] 재리뷰 시 해결된 지적 스레드가 남던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed re-reviews occasionally leaving a fixed finding's thread open when the new review also filed a lower-severity note under it

items.ko: [Code Review] 일시적 오류로 리뷰가 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed rare reviews ending with "Code review encountered an error" when GitHub or an internal service failed transiently at launch; they now wait and retry

items.ko: [Code Review] 지적 문구를 짧고 평이한 문장으로 개선
items.en: [Code Review] Improved how Code Review words each posted finding: short plain sentences that say who is affected, where the code goes wrong, and the fix up front

items.ko: [Code Review] 조직 한도로 건너뛴 리뷰 안내에 관리 페이지 링크 추가
items.en: [Code Review] Improved the check-run card and PR comment when a review is skipped because of an organization limit: each cause now links the admin page that fixes it

items.ko: LLM 게이트웨이용 요청 헤더 추가 (`CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`)
items.en: Added `x-claude-code-request-class`, `x-claude-code-agent-type`, `x-claude-code-prev-tool-durations`, `x-claude-code-compaction` and `x-claude-code-context-compacted` request headers for LLM gateways; opt in with `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`

items.ko: MCP 서버 연결 끊김·재연결 포기 시 알림 추가 (`/mcp` 안내)
items.en: Added a notification when an MCP server disconnects mid-session and automatic reconnection gives up, pointing at `/mcp`

items.ko: Claude 앱에서 원격 제어 세션 포크 추가 (백그라운드 세션으로 실행)
items.en: Added forking a session started with `claude --remote-control` or `/remote-control` from the Claude app; the fork runs as a background session on your computer

items.ko: 분석 불가 Bash 명령이 승인 프롬프트를 건너뛰던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash commands the permission checker cannot fully analyze skipping the prompt under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`, and a subshell hiding a dangerous `rm` in bypass mode

items.ko: 조직이 Skills 를 끈 뒤에도 동기화된 스킬이 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed skills synced from claude.ai staying available after your organization turns Skills off; they now move to the recoverable trash

items.ko: MDM·`managed-settings.json` 의 MCP 관리 설정이 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `allowManagedMcpServersOnly`, `deniedMcpServers` and `disableClaudeAiConnectors` set via MDM or `managed-settings.json` being ignored when server-managed settings are also present

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·Foundry 인증 오류가 `/login` 을 안내하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed 401/403 errors on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry, and Claude apps gateway 403s, telling you to run `/login`; the message now names the credential to refresh or points to your gateway administrator

items.ko: `/login`·`/upgrade` 가 이전 thinking 을 버려 캐시가 재작성되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/login`, `/upgrade`, and `/extra-usage` discarding earlier thinking from the conversation, which forced a full prompt-cache rewrite on the next request

items.ko: 자동 모드가 첨부 파일 업로드에서 승인을 묻고 멈추던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed auto mode stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploads a file you attached to the chat in a cloud or Remote Control session

items.ko: `.git` 이 사라진 뒤 `.git/info/exclude` 를 다시 만들던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a long-running session recreating a stub `.git/info/exclude` after the repository's `.git` directory was removed or moved away

items.ko: 셸 모드에서 맨 앞에 친 `!` 가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the main prompt dropping a `!` typed at the start while already in shell mode, so negated commands like `! grep …` can be typed

items.ko: macOS 에서 드래그한 스크린샷 Read 가 거부되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Read on macOS refusing a dragged-in screenshot, or any file the system reports under a second path, with "symlink resolution changed after permission was checked"

items.ko: 차단 설정에도 저장소가 지정한 메모리 디렉터리가 로드·색인되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`: a memory directory chosen by a repository's settings is no longer loaded into the prompt, recalled, indexed, or used by memory extraction

items.ko: 서브에이전트 결과가 전달되지 않고 실패로 보고되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sub-agents and background agents being reported as failed, with their result never delivered, when the final streamed reply omitted token usage or carried no model id

items.ko: advisor 턴을 두 배로 세어 자동 압축이 절반 지점에 돌던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the context meter and auto-compact counting advisor-tool turns at roughly twice their real context size, which made auto-compact fire at about half the real window

items.ko: 완료된 팀원 때문에 `/tui` 재시작이 거부되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/tui` refusing to restart because of an agent-team teammate that had already finished its work and was no longer shown in the agents panel

items.ko: `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` 복사 후 예약 작업이 다른 세션에서 돌던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed saved scheduled tasks running in the wrong session after `.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` was copied into another folder, such as a new worktree

items.ko: SDK·`stream-json` 출력에서 서브에이전트 메시지가 누락되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed SDK and `--output-format stream-json` output dropping a subagent's remaining messages and final report after it is moved to the background mid-run (e.g. by `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS`)

items.ko: `/install-github-app` 이 SAML 차단을 권한 부족으로 알리던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/install-github-app` reporting a SAML single sign-on block as "admin permissions required"

items.ko: 원격 제어 클라이언트의 컨텍스트 사용량 요청이 거부되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Remote Control clients attached to a Claude Desktop, VS Code or JetBrains session being refused when they ask for the session's context window usage

items.ko: 압축 상태 줄에 말줄임표가 두 번 표시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the spinner showing a doubled ellipsis ("……") on compaction status lines such as "Running PreCompact hooks…"

items.ko: Artifacts 사용 후 frontend-design 플러그인 추천이 잘못 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a false-positive spinner tip suggesting the frontend-design plugin after reading or publishing Artifacts

items.ko: 2.1.268 의 분석 불가 Bash 줄 거부 규칙 검사 되돌림
items.en: Reverted a 2.1.268 change that checked Read and Edit deny rules on Bash lines the permission checker can't analyze (`eval`, `env -C`); commands like `time -p make build` prompt again instead of being denied

items.ko: 긴 세션에서 훅·서브에이전트 갱신 시 반응성 개선
items.en: Improved responsiveness in long sessions: hook progress and sub-agent activity no longer re-process the whole conversation on every update

items.ko: 아티팩트가 지원하지 않는 파일 형식 발행 시 오류 안내 개선
items.en: Improved the Artifact tool's error when a publish includes a file type artifacts don't serve: Claude is told which types are served and what to do instead, and the terminal shows one plain line

items.ko: 아티팩트 페이지 읽기가 기능·데이터베이스 규칙을 알리도록 개선
items.en: Improved the Artifact tool's page read to state the capabilities and database rules the artifact service holds for the page, for anyone who can publish to it

items.ko: 아티팩트 데이터베이스 업데이트에서 단일 필드 삭제 지원
items.en: Improved artifact database writes: an update can now remove a single field instead of rewriting the whole document

items.ko: 아티팩트 발행 중 연결이 끊겨도 중복 없이 재전송하도록 개선
items.en: Improved artifact publishing: a publish whose connection drops after reaching claude.ai is now re-sent safely instead of failing or creating a duplicate version

items.ko: 클라우드 세션 GitHub 오류가 실제 원인을 표시하도록 개선
items.en: Improved the cloud-session GitHub error for an IP allow list, a suspended app installation or SAML single sign-on to show the cause instead of a generic install hint

items.ko: `/autofix-pr` 이 `gh pr view` 오류를 그대로 표시하도록 개선
items.en: Improved `/autofix-pr`: when `gh pr view` fails it now shows gh's own error (sign-in, SAML, rate limit) instead of a generic exit-code line

items.ko: `/autofix-pr` 이 웹훅 설정 실패 이유를 알리도록 개선
items.en: Improved `/autofix-pr` to say why GitHub webhook delivery couldn't be set up for the PR (for example, no linked GitHub account) instead of a generic warning

items.ko: `/web-setup` 의 토큰 거부·연결 실패 오류 안내 개선
items.en: Improved `/web-setup` errors: a refused GitHub token now lists the likely reasons and the fix, and a connection failure names a configured proxy or TLS certificate problem

items.ko: SSL 인증서·프록시 오류가 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 등 해결책을 안내하도록 개선
items.en: Improved the in-session SSL certificate and proxy connection errors to name the error code and what to fix, such as `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` for an untrusted corporate CA

items.ko: 로그인 만료로 클라우드 세션 생성 실패 시 `/login` 안내 개선
items.en: Improved the error when a cloud session can't be created because your Claude login expired or was revoked: it now tells you to run `/login`

items.ko: MCP 서버 인증 만료 오류가 `/mcp` 재인증을 안내하도록 개선
items.en: Improved the error shown when an MCP server's sign-in expires mid-session to say how to re-authenticate (`/mcp`)

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·Foundry 자동 모드 기본값을 로컬 분류기로 변경
items.en: Changed auto mode on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to use the local classifier by default for now; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` to use the platform's server-side classifier

items.ko: `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` 이 비용·토큰 지표에 실제 이름도 포함
items.en: Changed `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` to also include real agent, skill, plugin and MCP server names on cost and token metrics

items.ko: Claude 계정 로그인이 claude.ai 플러그인 접근 권한도 요청
items.en: Changed sign-in with a Claude account to also request access to your claude.ai plugins

items.ko: `/bug`·`/feedback` 이 요청 메타데이터와 `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` 를 제외
items.en: Changed `/bug` and `/feedback` reports to include only model-behavior params (model, system prompt, tools) from the last API request, omitting request metadata and `CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY` fields

items.ko: [VSCode] 피드백이 꺼진 조직에서 문제 신고가 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Report a problem" still appearing, and `/bug` / `/feedback` opening a report form, for organizations that have product feedback disabled

items.ko: [VSCode] Windows 에서 턴 종료 후 빨간 오류 배너가 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a red "Claude Code process exited with code 4294967295" banner appearing after completed turns on Windows

items.ko: Windows: `--add-dir` 로 추가한 네트워크 드라이브 UNC 경로 권한 검사 개선
items.en: Windows: Improved the network-path permission check for UNC paths when a mapped network drive was added with `--add-dir`

items.ko: [웹] 커넥터 재등록 후 루틴이 이전 커넥터를 호출하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed routines losing access to an organization connector, and still calling the old one, after an admin removed and re-added that connector

items.ko: [웹] 조직 설정에서 자체 호스팅 환경 생성이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed creating a self-hosted environment from organization settings occasionally failing with a server error and leaving a half-created environment behind

items.ko: [웹] 관리자 '클라우드 세션 공유' 설정이 데이터·개인정보 보호로 이동
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the admin "Share cloud sessions" setting to live under Data and privacy instead of the Claude Code page, where Data and privacy admins can also manage it

items.ko: [웹] 루틴 편집 이탈 시 '저장하지 않은 변경 취소' 확인 추가
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a "Discard unsaved changes?" confirmation before the New routine page or the Edit routine dialog throws away a routine name, prompt or edit you typed

items.ko: [웹] 신규 사용자에게 뜨던 데스크톱 앱 다운로드 전체 화면 제거
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Removed the full-page desktop-app download screen that new users without a cloud environment saw on Mac and Windows; they now go straight to setup

items.ko: [웹] 루틴 상세 페이지의 메뉴·실행 기록 배치 개선
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved the routine detail page: menu and rename in the breadcrumb, the on/off switch and Run now at the top, and run history beside the routine's settings

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Enterprise Grid 연결 해제 후 Claude 가 응답하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent minutes after reinstalling the app when an Enterprise Grid was disconnected but one of its workspaces stayed connected

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 조직 공유 비공개 채널의 예약 작업이 게시되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed scheduled tasks set up in an organization-shared private Slack channel silently never posting; they now keep running in the thread they were created in

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 이전 스레드 답글이 작업을 처음부터 다시 시작하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed replying in an older Slack thread while Claude is mid-task sometimes restarting it from scratch and losing work it had not pushed yet

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 토큰 갱신 직후 환경 없음 안내로 메시지가 누락되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude occasionally dropping a message with an incorrect "couldn't find a Claude Code environment" notice right after your account token refreshed

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 리전 없는 AWS 엔드포인트 연결이 거부되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed AWS connections refusing region-less endpoints such as Budgets, Savings Plans, WAF Classic and Import/Export; Global Accelerator requests now sign correctly

items.ko: [Claude Tag] AWS 요청 서명 실패 시 원인·해결 안내 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved AWS connection failures: when a request can't be signed, such as a hostname with no region, Claude is told why and how to fix it instead of a bare error

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 소문자 토큰 타입 제공자와의 OAuth 연결 실패 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed OAuth client-credentials and JWT-bearer connections failing with providers that return a lowercase token type; requests now send the standard Bearer scheme

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 일부 채널에서 채널 관리자 추가가 거부되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed adding a channel manager being refused on Enterprise Grid shared channels, on channels where Claude hasn't been used yet, and on legacy private channels

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Claude 가 관련 공개 채널을 스스로 지켜보도록 동작 변경
items.en: [Claude Tag] Changed Claude to start watching related public channels on its own, such as an incident channel a conversation depends on, instead of only when asked

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 관리자 메모리 페이지에 자동 추가 채널이 없던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the admin Memory page not listing Slack channels Claude set up on its own even when they had saved memory; admins can now open, edit and delete that memory

items.ko: [Code Review] 베이스 병합 시 전체 재리뷰가 돌던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed merging the base branch into a PR whose earlier review listed "Additional findings" triggering a full re-review; these pushes now get the lighter follow-up review

items.ko: [Code Review] `REVIEW.md` 전체가 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed a whole REVIEW.md being ignored because of an @-mention, a code span wrapped across lines, or a backticked HTML tag; only lines linking to changed files are withheld

items.ko: [Code Review] 제안 수정이 유지해야 할 동작을 명시하도록 개선
items.en: [Code Review] Improved suggested fixes to say what the fix must keep working when other code depends on the behavior being changed

items.ko: [Code Review] 두 번째 위치 지적이 잘려 나오던 것 개선
items.en: [Code Review] Improved review comments that point to a second affected location to state that location's issue in a full sentence instead of a cut-off stub

items.ko: [Code Review] `/ultrareview --post` 재시도 시 댓글 중복·누락 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed `/ultrareview --post` so a retry after a GitHub error posts the findings comment exactly once instead of never or twice; the comment now names the reviewed commit

items.ko: [Code Review] 대문자 포함 저장소에서 빈 푸시가 재리뷰되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed empty or content-identical pushes being re-reviewed on GitHub repositories whose owner or name contains a capital letter; these pushes are now skipped

items.ko: 버그 수정 및 안정성 개선
items.en: Bug fixes and reliability improvements

items.ko: Remote 세션(클라우드·자체 호스팅 러너)에서 fast mode 지원 추가
items.en: Added fast mode in Claude Code Remote sessions (cloud and self-hosted runners): the host's fast-mode setting or `/fast` typed in the session applies where your organization allows it

items.ko: 전체화면 `/config` 패널 마우스 조작 지원 추가
items.en: Added mouse support to the `/config` panel in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the settings list, a click on a setting's value changes it, and the row under the pointer is highlighted

items.ko: `claude self-hosted-runner` 에 `--drain-marker-file` 옵션 추가
items.en: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file <path>`: when that file exists at a SIGTERM drain, the runner reports its exit to the server as a host drain (telemetry only)

items.ko: auto 모드 샌드박스에 명령별 `allowed_domains` 추가
items.en: Added per-command `allowed_domains` to Bash, PowerShell and Monitor in auto mode with sandboxing: the hosts a command needs are reviewed with it and opened for it alone; other hosts are refused

items.ko: 서브에이전트가 CLAUDE.md 없이 실행되는 `omitClaudeMd` 추가
items.en: Added `omitClaudeMd` to agent frontmatter and `--agents` JSON, letting custom and plugin subagents run without user, project and local CLAUDE.md files; managed policy files still load

items.ko: `claude plugin install`·`update` 에 `--accept-command` 추가
items.en: Added `--accept-command <sha256>` to `claude plugin install` and `claude plugin update` to accept exactly the command a previous `--json` run displayed, instead of `-y`

items.ko: `modelPricing` 관리 설정에 1 초과 `multiplier` 지원 추가
items.en: Added support for a `multiplier` above 1, up to 10, in the `modelPricing` managed setting and the Claude apps gateway `pricing` block, for marked-up internal chargeback rates

items.ko: 데스크톱 앱 안내 스피너 팁과 `/desktop` 명령 추가
items.en: Added a spinner tip pointing Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry and LLM gateway users to the Claude desktop app; the claude.ai desktop app tip now suggests `/desktop`, which offers to download the app

items.ko: 계정·조직·API 키 전환 후 이전 조직 정책이 재사용되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a cached organization policy being reused after switching accounts, organizations, or API keys, and the policy not refreshing until the hourly check when the credential changes mid-session

items.ko: 조직 정책 로드·변경 시 도구·명령 목록이 갱신되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the tool and command lists not updating when the organization policy finishes loading after startup or changes mid-session

items.ko: 읽을 수 없는 `managed-mcp.json` 이 무시되던 문제 수정 (MCP 독점 제어 유지)
items.en: Fixed an enterprise `managed-mcp.json` that can't be read or parsed being ignored: it now keeps exclusive MCP control (user, project and plugin servers don't load) and warns at startup

items.ko: `ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET` 프록시를 통한 조직 정책 조회가 거부되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed org policy being fetched through, and rejected by, third-party local proxies set via `ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET`; they are again treated like other custom gateways, including for Remote Control

items.ko: 워커 재시작 후 클라우드 세션이 서브에이전트 호출을 모두 거부하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed cloud sessions rejecting every subagent tool call ("updatedInput … failed schema validation") when a workflow or agent approval was applied after the session's worker restarted

items.ko: 조직이 fast mode 를 끈 경우 `/fast off` 가 동작하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/fast off` answering "Fast mode unavailable" instead of turning fast mode off when the organization has fast mode disabled

items.ko: `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK` 세션이 fast 요청을 반복하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sessions started with `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK` re-sending fast requests every turn after the API rejected fast mode; the rejection now stands and its reason is shown

items.ko: `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` 에서 fast mode 폴백이 되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed fast mode under `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` failing the turn on a usage-credits limit, or retrying an overload at fast speed, instead of falling back to standard speed

items.ko: `fmt`·`column` 등이 읽는 파일을 Bash 권한 검사가 놓치던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash permission checks missing the file that `fmt`, `column` and similar commands read when it follows an option the checker doesn't recognize

items.ko: 와일드카드가 확장하는 파일을 Bash 권한 검사가 건너뛰던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash permission checks skipping files a wildcard expands to when the wildcard sits in a command's pattern or option value (for example `grep -v dir/* file`)

items.ko: 셸 변수 선언 플래그로 실행 명령을 위장할 수 있던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash permission checks so that shell variable declaration flags cannot misrepresent the command being run

items.ko: 작업 디렉터리 밖 읽기 확인 프롬프트가 건너뛰어지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash commands with two directory changes, a subshell, or a `cd`+`git` chain skipping the prompt under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` in bypass and auto mode

items.ko: 남은 `.git/config.lock` 으로 git 명령이 세션 내내 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a stale `.git/config.lock` breaking `git checkout -b`, `git push -u` and `git config` for the rest of a session after a sandboxed command failed to start (Linux)

items.ko: macOS 파일 이벤트 포화 시 설정 변경을 감지하지 못하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed settings file changes made outside the session going unnoticed on macOS machines whose system file-event service is saturated; the watcher now falls back to polling

items.ko: MCP 도구만 쓰는 `claude -p` 재개 세션이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed resumed `claude -p` sessions whose tools all come from MCP servers failing with "At least one tool must have defer_loading=false"

items.ko: LLM 게이트웨이가 `text/plain` 으로 응답하면 턴이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed turns failing with "API returned an empty or malformed response" when an LLM gateway returns the non-streaming reply as `text/plain`

items.ko: MCP `list_changed` 반복 알림으로 CPU 사용량이 치솟던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sustained high CPU usage and repeated tool-list requests when an MCP server sends `list_changed` notifications in a tight loop

items.ko: MCP OAuth 클라이언트 등록이 잘못 재사용·삭제되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed MCP OAuth mishandling client registrations: denying consent forced a new one, one for another redirect URI was reused, and a concurrent write could delete a valid one or keep a mismatched one

items.ko: MCP 도구를 짧은 이름으로 고르면 도구 검색이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed tool search returning no match when Claude selects an MCP tool by its bare name instead of its full `mcp__server__tool` name

items.ko: Ctrl+O 가 MCP 재연결을 취소하고 `/mcp` 가 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Ctrl+O cancelling pending MCP server reconnects, and `/mcp` sent from Remote Control failing while the transcript view is open

items.ko: ToolSearch 가 없는데 이를 쓰라고 지시하던 Claude in Chrome 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the Claude in Chrome prompt telling the model to load tools through ToolSearch when ToolSearch is unavailable

items.ko: 권한 정책에 막힌 세션 간 메시지가 흔적 없이 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed cross-session messages held by the receiving session's permission-mode policy leaving no trace: headless senders now get a delivery notice, and `SendMessage` results no longer imply it was read

items.ko: 컴팩션 후 실행 중인 백그라운드 명령이 중복 실행되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude starting a second copy of a background command (such as a watch task or dev server) that was still running after the conversation was compacted

items.ko: 원래 모델로 되돌릴 때도 `/model` 이 캐시 경고를 띄우던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/model` warning about losing the conversation cache when switching back to the model the conversation actually ran on

items.ko: `/cd` 후 `/reload-skills` 의 스킬 개수가 어긋나던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/reload-skills` reporting a skill count that disagreed with the slash menu after `/cd`

items.ko: 짧은 터미널에서 `/resume`·`/continue` 가 1~2개만 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/resume` and `/continue` showing only 1-2 sessions in fullscreen mode on short terminals

items.ko: `/resume`·`/teleport` 후 읽지 않은 파일을 수정할 수 있던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/resume` and `/teleport` keeping the previous conversation's file-read tracking, so Claude could edit files the resumed conversation had never read

items.ko: `--resume` 이 1M 컨텍스트(`[1m]`)를 잃던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `--resume` dropping the 1M context window (`[1m]`) when the resumed session's model family differs from the configured default model

items.ko: `--resume` 후 `/artifacts` 로 붙인 아티팩트가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed artifacts attached with `/artifacts` disappearing from the session after `--resume`

items.ko: 백그라운드 세션이 게시한 아티팩트의 재게시를 감시하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`, `claude agents`) not watching the artifacts they publish for republishes made elsewhere

items.ko: inode 0 가상 드라이브에서 에이전트·명령이 하나만 로드되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed custom agents, slash commands and output styles beyond the first not loading from a virtual drive that reports inode 0, such as an encrypted vault mounted as a Windows drive

items.ko: 자체 호스팅 러너의 호스트 설정 유실 수정, `--host-config-snapshot` 추가
items.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions silently losing all host config (settings, skills, plugins, MCP servers) when the host config directory exceeds 64 MiB; added `--host-config-snapshot disk|memory`

items.ko: 로그아웃 후 동기화된 스킬이 디스크에 계속 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed skills synced from claude.ai staying on disk indefinitely after signing out; copies not refreshed within `cleanupPeriodDays` now move to the recoverable trash at the next launch

items.ko: 사용할 수 없는 명령을 제안하던 스피너 팁 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed spinner tips suggesting commands that aren't available for your account type or are disabled in your session

items.ko: `/add-dir` 경로 입력의 좌우 커서 이동과 Enter 동작 수정
items.en: Fixed the `/add-dir` path input: the left and right arrow keys now move the cursor, and Enter adds only the typed path instead of also adding the highlighted completion

items.ko: 프롬프트 밖 입력란에서 맨 앞 `!` 가 뒤로 밀리던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed text fields outside the main prompt moving a leading `!` to the end of what you typed (`!foo` came out as `foo!`)

items.ko: `__proto__` 같은 이름의 훅 매처에서 `/hooks` 메뉴가 죽던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the interactive `/hooks` menu crashing when a hook matcher is named after an inherited object property such as `__proto__` or `constructor`

items.ko: 전체화면에서 텍스트에 이전 배경색이 남던 렌더링 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a fullscreen rendering glitch where text kept a stale background color after the box around it lost its background

items.ko: 붙은 백그라운드 세션에서 st Delete·rxvt Alt+화살표가 안 되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Delete in st and Alt+arrow keys in rxvt-unicode not working in attached background sessions

items.ko: 종료·중단 시 터미널 응답 문자(`^[[?1;2c`)가 새어 나오던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the terminal's replies to capability queries (`^[[?1;2c`) appearing at the shell prompt or in an editor when Claude Code exits, is suspended, or opens an editor right after starting

items.ko: 큰 diff·긴 대화 기록의 터미널 렌더링 성능 개선
items.en: Improved terminal rendering performance: large diffs and long transcripts render faster, with fewer slow frames

items.ko: 중복된 내장 모델 데이터 검증을 생략해 시작 시간 단축
items.en: Improved startup time slightly by skipping a redundant validation of built-in model data on every launch

items.ko: 훅 실행 중 스피너에 경과 시간 표시, SessionStart 훅은 Esc 로 취소
items.en: Improved hook feedback: while a SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse or SessionEnd hook runs, the spinner says so with elapsed time, and Esc cancels a prompt waiting on a SessionStart hook

items.ko: 긴 사고가 이어질 때의 스피너 상태 문구 개선
items.en: Improved the spinner status during long thinking: it now reads "deep in thought" after 45s, and shows "picking the thought back up" while recovering from the output-token limit

items.ko: 사용량 한도 도달 시 동적 워크플로가 중단 대신 일시정지 후 자동 재개
items.en: Improved dynamic workflows to pause when you hit your usage limit and continue automatically when it resets, instead of dropping the affected agents

items.ko: 네트워크 불안정 시 Remote Control 이 빈 세션을 덜 남기도록 개선
items.en: Improved Remote Control to leave fewer empty sessions on claude.ai when setup fails on a flaky network

items.ko: 브라우저 연결 실패 안내에 컴퓨터 절전 가능성 문구 추가
items.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: it now says the computer may be asleep before it suggests an install

items.ko: `claude mcp serve` 가 30초마다 진행 상태를 보내도록 개선
items.en: Improved `claude mcp serve`: a running tool call now sends a progress update every 30 seconds, so clients show it is still running and idle timeouts don't abort a long command that prints nothing

items.ko: Foundry·AWS 세션에서 `alwaysLoad` MCP 서버 사용성 개선
items.en: Improved Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS sessions: an `alwaysLoad` MCP server that finishes connecting mid-conversation is usable on the next turn without a tool-search round trip

items.ko: 아티팩트로 게시한 Markdown 이 문서 형식으로 렌더링되도록 개선
items.en: Improved Markdown files published as artifacts: they now render as styled document pages (title header, document typography, syntax-highlighted code)

items.ko: Artifact 도구의 게시 오류 메시지 개선
items.en: Improved Artifact tool publish errors: a publish with no file now says to write the page to a file first, and an unsupported file type is reported before a missing favicon

items.ko: Artifact 기능 오류에 지원되는 기능 목록을 함께 표시하도록 개선
items.en: Improved the Artifact tool's error when a page declares a capability its contract version lacks: it now lists every supported capability and notes when a newer contract version has it

items.ko: 세션이 동시에 감시하는 아티팩트를 5개에서 10개로 확대
items.en: Improved artifact watching: a session can now watch up to 10 published artifacts at once for republishes made elsewhere, up from 5

items.ko: pdfinfo 실패 시 PDF 페이지 수를 추측하지 않도록 개선
items.en: Improved PDF @-mentions to say "page count unknown" instead of a page count guessed from the file size when pdfinfo cannot count the pages

items.ko: `/mobile` 이 단일 QR 코드를 보여주도록 개선
items.en: Improved `/mobile` to show a single QR code for claude.ai/mobile, which opens the right app store for your phone

items.ko: auto 모드에서 스킬·명령의 `!` 셸 명령이 기본 권한 규칙을 따르도록 변경
items.en: Changed auto mode so that a skill's or slash command's inline `!` shell commands follow default-mode permission rules instead of the classifier; a command no rule decides runs as a reviewed tool call

items.ko: auto 모드 서브에이전트 결과를 분류기가 검토하는 전용 호출로 변경
items.en: Changed auto mode so a subagent reports back to its caller through a dedicated hand-back call that the safety classifier reviews, instead of its last message being reviewed after the fact

items.ko: Monitor 감시에 최대 30분 기한 적용, `persistent` 옵션 제거
items.en: Changed Monitor watches to always have a deadline (at most 30 minutes; 10 in single-prompt `-p` runs) and notify Claude to re-arm, replacing the no-timeout `persistent` option

items.ko: IDE 선택 표시를 줄바꿈되는 `[⧉ …]` 알약 형태로 변경
items.en: Changed the IDE selection indicator in the prompt to a `[⧉ …]` pill that wraps with the text instead of squeezing multi-line prompts; delete it with Backspace to leave the selection out

items.ko: Pro 기본 워크플로 크기를 small 로, medium 기준을 10 에이전트로 변경
items.en: Changed the default dynamic workflow size to small on Pro plans and lowered the medium size guideline from 15 to 10 agents

items.ko: 게이트웨이·Bedrock·Vertex·Foundry 세션의 claude.ai 로그인 갱신 중단
items.en: Changed Claude apps gateway, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry sessions so that they no longer refresh a leftover claude.ai login that the session does not use

items.ko: 번들 `claude-api` 스킬을 스트리밍 도구·Managed Agents 기준으로 갱신
items.en: Updated the bundled `claude-api` skill to enable `eager_input_streaming` on streaming custom tools, and to start deliverable-shaped Managed Agents work with `user.define_outcome`

items.ko: [VSCode] 열린 파일 첨부를 끄는 Attach Open File 설정 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added an Attach Open File setting that, when turned off, stops the open file from being added to messages; selected text is still attached

items.ko: [VSCode] 훅·권한 규칙 대화상자가 저장 성공을 실패로 알리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs reporting a save that landed as failed, and the Hooks dialog going blank under a plugin-only policy lock or showing color codes in save errors

items.ko: [VSCode] 훅 저장 시 중복 훅·시크릿 유실·gitignore 누락 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Hooks dialog saves: no duplicate hook on replace, a header name retyped in other capitals keeps its secret, and settings.local.json is gitignored before the save returns

items.ko: [VSCode] Windows 네트워크·SUBST 드라이브에서 세션 기록이 안 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed session history showing only the current session when the workspace is on a Windows mapped network drive or SUBST drive

items.ko: [VSCode] 세션 목록 Active 필터가 열린 유휴 세션을 숨기던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list's Active filter hiding open idle sessions when Open is also checked in the filter menu

items.ko: [VSCode] 세션 목록 새로고침 시 새 채팅이 이전 채팅으로 바뀌던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a new chat switching back to the previous chat when the session list refreshed

items.ko: [VSCode] `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 변경이 창 재시작 전까지 반영되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed open tabs and the side bar keeping the old config folder until a window reload after `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` changed in the `environmentVariables` setting

items.ko: [VSCode] Windows 에서 백그라운드 명령 실행 시 콘솔 창이 깜빡이던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed console windows flashing on Windows when the extension runs background commands such as git, ripgrep, and the sign-in status check

items.ko: [VSCode] 캐시 시계 툴팁 지연과 자동 컴팩트 아이콘 툴팁 중복 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock's hover text appearing only after a delay, and the auto-compact icon showing the browser's own tooltip beside its popup

items.ko: [VSCode] 설정 파일 문제로 훅 저장이 거부될 때 안내 팝업 제공
items.en: [VSCode] Improved the Hooks dialog: a save refused because of the settings file itself now opens a popup with an "Open settings file" button and the reason behind "Copy error"

items.ko: [VSCode] 토글 스위치 켜짐 색을 에디터 테마 버튼 색으로 변경
items.en: [VSCode] Changed the on state of toggle switches from Claude orange to the editor theme's button color

items.ko: [Claude Code on the web] 종료된 클라우드 세션이 10분간 응답하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed a cloud session sometimes taking about ten minutes to respond after its process exited while the session still looked live; sending a message now restarts it right away

items.ko: [Claude Code on the web] Routines 페이지 새 레이아웃 적용, 캘린더 보기 제거
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the Routines page on claude.ai/code to a new layout with Yours and Templates tabs and two-column routine cards that show run status, and removed its calendar view

items.ko: [Claude Code on the web] 관리자 설정에 Custom network access 옵션 추가
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added a Custom network access option to the Cloud environments editor in admin settings, with the same allowed-domains list the environment dialog on claude.ai/code offers

items.ko: [Claude Code on the web] 클라우드 환경 관리자 페이지 정보 표시 개선
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved the Cloud environments admin page: it shows the default environment for Claude Tag and Claude Code, with a link to change it, and marks the recommended kind to create

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 스레드 위주 채널에서 작업 맥락이 매시간 초기화되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a channel where it stays active losing its working context about once an hour when the conversation is mostly in threads; thread activity now keeps it from being reset

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 재시작 후 스레드의 PR 감시가 끊기던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a thread that asked Claude to watch a pull request no longer hearing about CI failures, comments and reviews after Claude was restarted in that thread

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 답변한 스레드의 첫 메시지를 지워도 작업이 멈추지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed deleting the first message of a thread Claude had already replied in not ending Claude's work there; it now stops, as it did when a message with no replies was deleted

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 다른 봇에게 한 지시 때문에 게시를 보류하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude holding back a post because of an earlier instruction addressed to a different bot or assistant; only instructions addressed to Claude bind it, and it asks when unsure

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 답변 모드 카드가 잘못된 이유를 표시하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the reply-mode card Claude posts on joining a busy channel saying it "sees a lot of automated posts" when the channel is only chatty or large; the card now names the real reason

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 관리자 설정 Environment 선택기에 호스팅 종류 표시 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the Environment picker in Claude Tag admin settings: options are labeled Anthropic-hosted or self-hosted, with links to edit that environment or create one

items.ko: [Code Review] 리뷰 대기 중 커밋이 오면 리뷰가 누락되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed a pull request in a repository reviewed once per PR sometimes getting no review when a commit arrived while its review was waiting to start; it now reviews the requested commit

items.ko: [Code Review] 같은 지적을 두세 번 중복 게시하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review occasionally posting the same findings two or three times when GitHub reported an error for a review it had in fact created

items.ko: [Code Review] 이미 해결된 보안 지적이 다시 게시되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed follow-up reviews re-posting a security finding a person had already resolved when a later push moved the lines it was anchored to

items.ko: [Code Review] 끝난 `/ultrareview` 세션을 열면 리뷰가 다시 시작되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Code Review] Fixed reopening a finished /ultrareview cloud session in the Claude app starting the whole review over again unprompted

items.ko: Windows: 임시 출력 경로가 260자에 이르면 PowerShell 명령이 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands failing with "Exit code 1" and no output when the session's temp output path reaches 260 characters

items.ko: 장시간 세션에서 읽기 전용 git 명령이 권한을 묻던 회귀 수정
items.en: Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)

items.ko: 플러그인 eval 스위트를 실행해 채점 결과(JSON·HTML)를 내는 `claude plugin eval` 추가
items.en: Added `claude plugin eval`: run a plugin's eval suite against Claude Code and get scored, reproducible results (JSON + HTML report); see `claude plugin eval --help`

items.ko: 출력 스타일 목록·전환용 `/output-style [name]` 추가 (Remote Control·헤드리스 포함)
items.en: Added `/output-style [name]` to list and switch output styles, including over Remote Control and in cloud and other headless sessions

items.ko: Bash 도구가 파일을 수정하면 결과에 변경 diff 표시 (`bashEditDiffEnabled`)
items.en: Added a diff of the files a Bash command changed to the Bash tool result when the Bash tool handles file edits (setting `bashEditDiffEnabled`)

items.ko: OpenTelemetry 지표에 `vcs.*` 저장소 속성을 붙이는 `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY` 추가
items.en: Added `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY` to tag OpenTelemetry metrics and events with `vcs.*` repository attributes; commit events get `vcs.ref.head.*` with `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`

items.ko: LLM 게이트웨이 `/v1/models` 탐색 타임아웃 연장 환경변수 추가 (기본 3초)
items.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS` to extend the LLM gateway `/v1/models` discovery timeout (default 3s)

items.ko: 프롬프트·작업 요약·응답만 보는 `/focus` 를 권하는 스피너 팁 추가
items.en: Added a spinner tip suggesting `/focus` for a view with just your prompt, a one-line work summary, and the response

items.ko: Workflow 동시 에이전트 상한 조정용 `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS` 추가
items.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS` (1–256) to raise the Workflow tool's per-run concurrent agent limit for inference-bound fan-outs

items.ko: 출력 토큰 한도로 잘린 응답을 이어받은 다음 턴에 프롬프트 캐시가 일부 무효화되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the prompt cache being partially invalidated on the turn after a response was cut off at the output-token limit and automatically resumed

items.ko: 생각 도중 중단한 세션을 재개하면 이전 맥락 재전송이 바뀌어 캐시 재사용이 떨어지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a case where resuming a session after interrupting Claude mid-thought could change how earlier context was re-sent, hurting prompt-cache reuse

items.ko: kitty 프로토콜 F1/F2/F4, st 의 Delete, rxvt 의 Alt+화살표, WezTerm 의 Shift+문장부호 수정
items.en: Fixed F1/F2/F4 not working in kitty-protocol terminals and Delete in st, Alt+arrows acting as Escape in rxvt-unicode, and Shift+punctuation typing the unshifted key in WezTerm (regression in 2.1.247)

items.ko: 백그라운드 에이전트 실행 중에도 원격·헤드리스 세션이 입력 대기로 보고되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed remote and headless sessions reporting "waiting for your input" while background agents were still running (set `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0` to restore the old behavior)

items.ko: 일부 터미널에서 기능 질의 응답(`^[[?1;2c`)이 시작 시 잡문자로 찍히던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the terminal's replies to capability queries (`^[[?1;2c`) appearing as stray text at startup in some terminals

items.ko: 터미널 크기 변경 후 전체화면에서 트랜스크립트 위·아래 줄이 비던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed rows at the top or bottom of the transcript going blank in fullscreen after resizing the terminal

items.ko: `!` 로 시작하는 deny·ask 권한 규칙이 작성한 설정 소스 밖까지 적용되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a deny or ask permission rule starting with `!` applying beyond the settings source that wrote it; such a rule now applies only within its own source, and a bare `!` negation is ignored

items.ko: 압축 후 전달되는 git 상태가 세션 시작 시점이 아닌 현재 상태가 되도록 수정
items.en: Fixed the git status Claude is told after a compaction: it is now the current status, not the one from the start of the session

items.ko: 원격 세션 재개 시 동기화된 플러그인 MCP 서버가 연결되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed synced plugin MCP servers not connecting when a remote session resumes

items.ko: 재개된 헤드리스 세션에서 모델 전환·재시도 시 해당 턴의 응답이 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed resumed headless sessions losing a turn's replies when the model was switched or a request was retried mid-turn

items.ko: 배경 작업 기록의 터미널 이스케이프 코드·과다 텍스트가 작업 목록·알림에 새던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed terminal escape codes, line breaks and oversized text from a background task's on-disk record reaching the task list and task notifications when work is resumed

items.ko: CMYK JPEG 이미지 첨부가 디코딩 실패하던 문제 수정 — 이제 다른 JPEG 처럼 변환
items.en: Fixed CMYK JPEG images failing to attach with "cannot decode"; they are now converted and resized like other JPEGs

items.ko: 스킴 없이 지정한 gRPC 텔레메트리 수집기가 관리 설정 승인 창에 표기되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the managed settings approval dialog not naming the collector for a gRPC telemetry endpoint set without a scheme

items.ko: 플러그인 `headersHelper` 동의 창의 URL 경로가 다른 호스트로 오인될 수 있던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugin `headersHelper` consent prompts showing a URL path that could be misread as a different host

items.ko: `@` 로 시작하는 폴더명의 윈도우 상대 경로가 `[redacted URL]` 로 가려지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugin errors showing `[redacted URL]` in place of a relative Windows path with a folder name that starts with `@`

items.ko: 터미널 네이티브 커서 사용 시 권한 규칙·디렉터리 추가 등 입력란의 커서가 없던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed missing cursor in the permission-rule, auto-mode-rule, add-directory, session-rename and feedback-review text fields when the terminal's native cursor is enabled

items.ko: `/fork` 영수증을 1초 안에 연달아 클릭하면 세션이 바로 백그라운드로 가지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed repeated clicks on a `/fork` receipt, each under a second apart, never backgrounding the session right away while it waited for the current tool to finish

items.ko: `shutdown` 을 거부하는 플러그인 LSP 서버(rust-analyzer 등)가 종료되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugin LSP servers that reject `shutdown` params (e.g. rust-analyzer) being left running at session end; `exit` is now sent even if `shutdown` fails

items.ko: 귀속 문구 안내가 CLAUDE.md·메모리의 귀속 금지 규칙을 덮어쓰던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the attribution reminder overriding a CLAUDE.md or memory rule against commit and pull request attribution; lines set by managed settings still apply

items.ko: 일본어·중국어·태국어 등 띄어쓰기 없는 언어에서 프롬프트 제안이 버려지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed prompt suggestions being dropped for text in Japanese, Chinese, Thai and other languages written without spaces between words

items.ko: GNOME 터미널·Konsole 구버전에서 동기 출력 지원을 이름만 보고 단정하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed synchronized output being assumed from the terminal's name in GNOME Terminal and Konsole versions that do not support it

items.ko: 경로 deny 규칙에 막힌 Read·Edit·Write 가 `permission_denials` 에서 빠지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `permission_denials` in `--output-format stream-json` results omitting Read, Edit and Write calls blocked by a path-scoped deny rule

items.ko: SDK·데스크톱 앱 세션이 다른 세션의 에이전트 목록에서 알 수 없음으로 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sessions run through the SDK or the desktop app showing an unknown status in other sessions' agent list

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·Foundry·게이트웨이에서 `/insights` 가 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/insights` failing on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and gateway deployments whose account can't reach the default Opus model by using the session model there instead

items.ko: 다른 프로세스가 동시에 로그인을 갱신하면 조직 정책 한도가 로드되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed organization policy limits not loading for the session when another Claude Code process refreshed the login at the same moment

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·게이트웨이 사용 데스크톱 세션이 턴 종료 알림 문구를 받지 못하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude Desktop sessions using Bedrock, Vertex, or a gateway not getting the contextual "what Claude needs" turn-end notification text

items.ko: 서버 URL 쿼리 파라미터 순서만 바뀌어도 MCP 서버가 재연결되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed MCP servers reconnecting when an updated config only changed the order of the server URL's query parameters

items.ko: 백그라운드 에이전트 이름·설명이 길거나 줄바꿈이면 프롬프트 상단 테두리가 갈라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the prompt box's top border splitting into extra lines when viewing a background agent whose name or description has line breaks or is wider than the terminal

items.ko: 요약할 이전 대화가 없어 자동 압축이 막히면 세션이 프롬프트 초과로 굳던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sessions getting permanently stuck on "Prompt is too long" when auto-compaction had no complete earlier exchange to summarize (mostly Agent SDK sessions with very large prompts)

items.ko: API 오류·네트워크 끊김·토큰 한도에서 `/goal` 이 조용히 멈추던 문제 수정 (재시도·사유 안내)
items.en: Fixed `/goal` runs silently stalling after API errors, network drops, or token limits: the goal now retries with backoff, or pauses and says why, including until a usage limit resets

items.ko: 클라우드 세션에서 서버 설정을 기다리지 않아 생기던 프롬프트 캐시 미스 수정
items.en: Fixed prompt cache misses in cloud sessions by waiting briefly for server configuration before the first request

items.ko: `/btw` 답변에 지어낸 도구 호출·출력이 섞이던 문제 수정 — 나타나면 미실행으로 표시
items.en: Fixed `/btw` answers that contained made-up tool calls and output: the side question is now told not to write them, and any that appear are flagged as not executed

items.ko: `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 이 6시간 넘게 지난 실패 턴까지 재실행하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that had failed with an API error over 6 hours earlier, or longer ago than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` when set

items.ko: 관리 설정으로 켠 조직 플러그인이 헤드리스·데스크톱에서 로드되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed organization plugins enabled through managed settings not loading in headless sessions and on Claude Desktop (once Desktop bundles this CLI version); they load from the next session

items.ko: 세션용으로 푼 플러그인 아카이브를 다른 로컬 사용자가 읽고 쓸 수 있던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugin archives extracted for a session being readable by other local users, extracted files keeping world-writable bits from the archive, and stale files surviving re-extraction

items.ko: Bash `tee` 가 쓰는 파일에 `Edit()` deny 규칙·쓰기 경로 검사가 적용되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `Edit()` deny rules and the write-path check not applying to the file a Bash `tee` command writes; a `Bash(tee:*)` allow rule no longer covers destinations outside the working directories

items.ko: 느린 연결(ssh·브라우저 터미널)에서 `22c` 등 잡문자가 시작 시 프롬프트에 입력되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed stray characters like `22c`, or a terminal's color or version reply, being typed into the prompt at startup over slow connections (ssh, browser terminals)

items.ko: rxvt-unicode 에서 전체화면을 드나든 뒤 블록 커서가 화면 아래 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the terminal's block cursor showing under the interface in rxvt-unicode after leaving or re-entering fullscreen

items.ko: rxvt-unicode 전체화면에서 외부 편집기 복귀 후 블록 커서가 남던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the cursor block staying visible after returning from an external editor in fullscreen mode on rxvt-unicode

items.ko: 전체화면이 아닐 때 외부 편집기(Ctrl+G) 복귀 후 화면이 두 번 그려지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the interface being drawn twice after returning from an external editor (Ctrl+G) outside fullscreen mode

items.ko: Konsole 에서 외부 편집기 복귀 후 화면이 두 번 그려지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the interface being drawn twice in Konsole after returning from an external editor

items.ko: Windows: 백그라운드로 보낸 PowerShell 명령이 Claude Code 종료 시 멈추던 문제 수정
items.en: Windows: Fixed PowerShell tool commands sent to the background stopping when Claude Code exits

items.ko: `/diff` 패널이 로딩 상태 없이 한 번에 완성된 화면으로 열리도록 개선
items.en: Improved the `/diff` panel to open fully rendered in one step instead of showing a loading state first

items.ko: 한국어·일본어·중국어 프롬프트 제안 필터링 개선 — 혼합 문자·단일 단어 제안 유지
items.en: Improved prompt suggestion filtering for Japanese, Chinese and Korean text: mixed-script and single-word suggestions are kept, and meta or evaluative text is dropped as it is for English

items.ko: Skill 도구의 Unknown skill 오류가 일치하는 플러그인 스킬의 전체 이름을 알려주도록 개선
items.en: Improved the Skill tool's "Unknown skill" error to name the plugin skill's full name when a bare name matches exactly one plugin skill

items.ko: SSH·미인식 터미널 키보드 지원 개선 — foot·Alacritty 0.16+ 에서 Shift+Enter 동작
items.en: Improved keyboard support over SSH and in unrecognized terminals: terminals that answer the kitty keyboard query (such as foot and Alacritty 0.16+) now get Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Shift shortcuts

items.ko: 긴 세션 반응성 개선 — 트랜스크립트 갱신 때 대화 전체를 다시 처리하지 않음
items.en: Improved responsiveness in long sessions: transcript updates no longer re-process the whole conversation to build the collapsed tool-use summaries

items.ko: 대화 도중 연결된 `alwaysLoad` MCP 서버를 다음 턴에서 바로 쓰도록 개선
items.en: Improved first-party sessions with telemetry disabled: an `alwaysLoad` MCP server that finishes connecting mid-conversation is usable on the next turn without a tool-search round trip

items.ko: `/ultrareview --post` 가 결과 도착 즉시 PR 코멘트를 올리고 링크를 출력하도록 변경
items.en: Changed `/ultrareview --post` to post the PR comment directly when the findings arrive and print the comment link, instead of starting a second cloud session to post it

items.ko: 세션 스크래치패드에 저장하는 아티팩트 DB 읽기에서 작업 폴더 승인을 받지 않도록 변경
items.en: Changed artifact database reads that save into the session scratchpad so they no longer stop for working-folder approval

items.ko: 클라우드 세션의 claude.ai 동기화 스킬 이름을 `anthropic-skills:<name>` 으로 변경
items.en: Changed skills synced from claude.ai in cloud sessions to be named `anthropic-skills:<name>`, matching Claude Desktop; the bare name still works when nothing else uses it

items.ko: [VSCode] 하단 N agents 알약으로 여는 서브에이전트 맵 추가 (카드·중지·읽기 전용 기록)
items.en: [VSCode] Added an agent map: an "N agents" footer pill opens a map of the session's sub-agents with per-agent cards, Stop agent, and read-only transcripts

items.ko: [VSCode] 훅 조회·추가·수정·삭제용 Hooks 대화상자 추가 (관리·플러그인 훅은 읽기 전용)
items.en: [VSCode] Added a Hooks dialog to the command menu for viewing hooks and adding, editing, or removing them in user, project, and local settings; managed, plugin, and session hooks stay read-only

items.ko: [VSCode] Focus 뷰의 도구 호출 그룹 아래에 실행 중 서브에이전트 진행 행 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added live progress rows for running subagents under the tool-call groups in Focus view

items.ko: [VSCode] 권한 규칙 조회·추가·삭제용 대화상자 추가 (관리·세션 전용 규칙은 읽기 전용)
items.en: [VSCode] Added a Permission rules dialog that lists permission rules and adds or removes them in user, project, and local settings; startup-option, session-only, and managed rules stay read-only

items.ko: [VSCode] 계정 전환 화면에 현재 계정으로 세션에 돌아가는 Cancel 버튼 추가
items.en: [VSCode] Added a Cancel button to the Switch account screen that returns to your session as the current account

items.ko: [VSCode] 예약 작업 등 전달된 텍스트 프롬프트의 턴이 이전 턴에 묶여 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Focus view showing a turn started by a delivered plain-text prompt, such as a scheduled task's, as part of the previous turn

items.ko: [VSCode] 패널이 좁을 때 하단 프롬프트 캐시 시계의 분이 가려지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the footer's prompt cache clock hiding its minutes when the panel is narrow

items.ko: [VSCode] `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 설정 시 세션 목록에 기본 폴더 세션이 남던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list keeping sessions from the default folder when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in a settings file or the `environmentVariables` setting

items.ko: [VSCode] 늦게 로딩된 플랜 미리보기가 코멘트 상자를 가리거나 옛 플랜을 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a plan preview that finished loading late sometimes hiding its comment box or showing an older plan

items.ko: [VSCode] Claude 탭을 닫은 뒤 플랜 미리보기가 전달되지 않는 코멘트를 받던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a plan preview accepting comments that went nowhere after its Claude tab closed

items.ko: [VSCode] 마지막 응답 후 압축·종료한 세션의 캐시 시계·재개 안내가 콜드로 표시되도록 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock and reopen notice for a session compacted after its last reply and then closed, which now reads as cold when reopened

items.ko: [VSCode] Remote Control 중 확장에서 바꾼 세션 이름이 claude.ai/code 에 반영 안 되던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session renamed in the extension while Remote Control is on keeping its old name on claude.ai/code

items.ko: [VSCode] 터미널에서 설정을 기본값으로 되돌려도 Remote Control 토글이 남던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" toggle keeping its last position after the setting was reset to default from a terminal

items.ko: [VSCode] 창 재로드 후 복원된 Claude 탭이 열린 것으로 세지 않아 탭이 중복 열리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed restored Claude tabs not counting as open in the session list after a window reload until clicked, and their row opening a second tab

items.ko: [VSCode] 같은 계정으로 재로그인하면 닫아둔 사용량 한도 경고가 되살아나던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Switch account making a tab forget its dismissed usage-limit warnings when you sign back in as the same account

items.ko: [VSCode] 긴 턴 중 바꾼 세션 이름이 창 재로드 후 자동 생성 이름으로 돌아가던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a session rename being replaced by the generated name after a window reload when the session was renamed during a long turn

items.ko: [VSCode] 계정에서 사라진 모델별 주간 한도 행이 사이드바 사용량계에 남던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sidebar usage meter keeping a stale per-model weekly limit row after the account loses that limit

items.ko: [VSCode] 새 채팅 뷰 시작 중 단축키로 보낸 @멘션이 한참 뒤 입력되던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed a rare case where an @-mention sent with the keyboard shortcut while a new chat view was still starting could be inserted into the input long after the keystroke

items.ko: [VSCode] 사이드바를 열 때 계정·사용량 헤더가 늦게 떠 세션 목록이 밀리던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list jumping down when the Account & usage header appeared a moment after opening the Claude side bar

items.ko: [VSCode] 사용자가 아닌 제3자를 위한 문서·메시지는 그 독자에 맞춰 쓰고 대상을 명시하도록 개선
items.en: [VSCode] Improved documents and messages written for someone other than the user: Claude now writes them for that audience and names it at the top of its reply

items.ko: [VSCode] 슬래시 명령·@멘션 메뉴, 권한 카드 등의 스크린리더·키보드 접근성 개선
items.en: [VSCode] Improved screen reader and keyboard accessibility in the slash-command menu, @-mention menu, output-style picker, Send/Stop button, permission and question cards, and onboarding checklist

items.ko: [VSCode] 메시지 상자의 현재 파일 칩에서 Hide 토글 대신 X 로 제거하도록 변경
items.en: [VSCode] Changed the current-file chip in the message box: an X now removes it, replacing the Hide toggle

items.ko: [VSCode] 세션 탭 우클릭 메뉴와 편집기 제목 표시줄의 Claude Code 항목 제거
items.en: [VSCode] Removed the Claude Code items from a session tab's right-click menu and the editor title bar's "..." menu; they could not act on the tab the menu was opened on

items.ko: [웹] 클라우드 세션에서 Claude 가 읽기 전 대기 메시지를 되가져오는 기능 추가 (Esc·Up)
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Added taking back a queued message in a cloud session before Claude reads it: remove it from the queue, or press Esc or Up, and the text returns to the message box

items.ko: [웹] 모델이 제한된 조직에서 `/model default` 이후 모든 메시지가 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed `/model default` in a cloud session leaving every later message failing in organizations that restrict which models Claude Code can use

items.ko: [웹] 일시적 서버 오류 후 1회성 예약 루틴이 한 번 더 실행되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed one-off scheduled routines occasionally running a second time after a transient server error

items.ko: [웹] 서브에이전트를 쓰는 루틴 실행이 일찍 완료로 처리돼 재시도 누락·중복 실행되던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed routine runs that use subagents sometimes being treated as finished too early, which could skip the retry after a real failure or start a duplicate run

items.ko: [웹] 저장소 하위 폴더에서 작업할 때 클라우드 기록의 파일 링크가 404 나던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Fixed file links in cloud session transcripts opening a GitHub 404 when Claude was working from a subfolder of the repository

items.ko: [웹] 클라우드 환경 관리자 페이지가 5행 제한 없이 전체 환경을 표시하도록 변경
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the Cloud environments admin page to list every environment instead of capping each table at five rows behind a Show more control that could be unreachable

items.ko: [웹] 무료 플랜 사용자에게 차단 안내 대신 업그레이드 경로가 있는 요금제 페이지를 열도록 변경
items.en: [Claude Code on the web] Changed claude.ai/code for Free-plan users to open the plans page with a path to upgrade, instead of a "Disabled by org admin" page with no way forward

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 관리 설정의 GitHub 연결 전체 연결·해제 전 확인 대화상자 추가
items.en: [Claude Tag] Added a confirmation dialog before Connect all or Disconnect on a GitHub installation in admin settings, to guard against accidental organization-wide changes

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Slack 레이트 리밋으로 실패 알림이 유실돼 스레드가 조용해지던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed threads occasionally going silent after a failed turn because the failure notice was dropped when Slack briefly rate-limited it; the notice is now retried

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 조직이 허용하지 않은 모델로 전환을 받아들이고 조용히 대체 모델로 답하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude accepting a switch to a model your organization hasn't enabled and then quietly answering with a fallback model; it now declines and says an admin can enable it

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 같은 메시지에 파일을 첨부하면 표가 파이프 텍스트로 올라가던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a table posting as raw pipe text when Claude attached files to the same message; the table now posts as a normal reply and the files follow with a plain caption

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 비활성 채널 최상위의 `@Claude !restart` 가 엉뚱한 대화를 시작하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` at the top level of a channel where Claude isn't active starting an unrelated conversation; it now privately says there is nothing to restart

items.ko: [Claude Tag] Slack 접근 설정의 플러그인 행이 raw ID 로 떠 끌 수 없던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed plugin rows in Slack access settings showing an unlabeled raw ID with no way to turn the plugin off; they now show its name and link to the bundle that manages it

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 공유 세션 배너·공유 창이 조직 전체 공개로 잘못 안내하던 문제 수정
items.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed the shared-session banner and Share dialog on sessions started from Slack claiming the whole organization could open the link; they now name the Slack channel's audience

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 관리 설정 페이지와 Slack 채널 선택기 로딩 속도 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved load time of the admin settings page and its Slack channel picker, most noticeably for organizations with many channels or several connected workspaces

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 예약 루틴 실행이 새 채널 글 대신 기존 스레드에 답하도록 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved scheduled routines in Slack channels: a routine run can now reply in an existing thread instead of always posting a new top-level channel message

items.ko: [Claude Tag] 진행 체크리스트 시각을 UTC 대신 각자의 현지 시각·경과 시간으로 개선
items.en: [Claude Tag] Improved the timestamp on Claude's live progress checklists to show each reader's local time and how long ago it was updated, instead of a fixed UTC time

items.ko: Claude apps 게이트웨이 `pricing:` 요율을 로그인한 클라이언트에 전달하는 기능 추가
items.en: Added to the Claude apps gateway: with `pricing:` set in `gateway.yaml`, signed-in Claude Code clients receive the same rates through managed settings, so `/cost` and telemetry match the spend meter

items.ko: 게이트웨이 `access_control.allow_cidrs` 가 비었을 때 시작 경고 추가
items.en: Added a startup warning for gateways when `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty, and a one-time warning the first time a request arrives from a public address

items.ko: 조직 공용 IPv4 대역에서 `/login` 을 허용하는 `gatewayInternalNetworks` 설정 추가
items.en: Added the `gatewayInternalNetworks` managed setting, letting administrators allow `/login` to a Claude apps gateway on their organization's own public IPv4 block

items.ko: 세션 종료 시 세션별 디렉터리를 지우는 `--remove-session-state` 옵션 추가
items.en: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state` (default off): delete each session's per-session directories under `<base-dir>/_sessions/` when the session ends

items.ko: `claude auth status --json` 출력에 `configDirectory` 추가
items.en: Added `configDirectory` to the output of `claude auth status --json`

items.ko: `claude plugin` 하위 명령에 `--json` 과 상세 오류·안내 필드 추가
items.en: Added `--json` to `claude plugin install`, `uninstall`, `update`, `enable` and `disable`, and `errorDetails`/`noteDetails` to each row of `claude plugin list --json`

items.ko: 게시된 아티팩트에 페이지에 맞는 브라우저 탭 아이콘 추가
items.en: Added browser-tab icons for published artifacts, chosen by Claude to match each page

items.ko: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 서드파티 엔드포인트에서 매 턴 HTTP 400 이 나던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed every turn failing with HTTP 400 on third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoints (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) since 2.1.265: a regex in the Artifact tool's input schema that those endpoints reject

items.ko: 응답을 끝내지 않는 서버에서 WebFetch 가 무한 대기하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed WebFetch hanging indefinitely on a server that keeps the response open without finishing; a fetch now fails after 300 seconds. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS` to override the deadline (0 turns it off)

items.ko: 신뢰하지 않은 폴더의 동명 에이전트 파일을 재생성된 팀메이트가 쓰던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a respawned in-process teammate picking up tools or a system prompt from a same-named agent file in a folder you have not trusted

items.ko: 유휴 세션의 바쁜 루프로 CPU 점유가 계속 높던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed sustained high CPU usage: a busy loop in long-running idle sessions no longer pins a CPU core, and rapid terminal focus reports during a session recap no longer keep the CPU high

items.ko: MCP 도구 호출 뒤 메시지가 비었다는 답이 나오던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude sometimes replying "your message came through empty" after an MCP tool call

items.ko: 심볼릭 링크 디렉터리에서 deny·ask 권한 규칙이 적용되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed deny and ask permission rules on symlinked directories (`/etc`, `/tmp`, `/var` on macOS; `/bin` on Linux) not applying when a path was given by its real location, and Bash commands ignoring deny rules written on a symlinked path spelling

items.ko: `env -C`·`eval` 이 같은 줄에 있으면 Read·Edit deny 규칙이 빠지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a case where a Read or Edit deny rule did not apply when an `env -C`, `eval` or similar command the permission checker cannot analyze was on the same line

items.ko: 플러그인·마켓플레이스 오류에 git URL 의 토큰·비밀번호가 노출되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugin and marketplace errors showing a token or password from a git source URL

items.ko: `/mcp`·`/plugin` 등이 MCP 설정의 `${VAR}` 비밀값을 노출하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/mcp` and `/plugin` server details, `claude mcp list`/`get`, and MCP login errors showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs

items.ko: SDK `excludeDynamicSections` 세션에서 프롬프트 캐싱과 확장 사고가 깨지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed prompt caching and extended thinking breaking mid-session for SDK sessions using `excludeDynamicSections`: the first message is no longer re-rendered each request

items.ko: 오래된 모델 접근 거부 캐시로 권한 있는 사용자가 제한 안내를 받던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed entitled users being told a model is restricted after restart or in the Desktop Code tab when a cached model-access denial was stale

items.ko: 다른 프로세스의 갱신으로 실행 중 세션이 조직 기본 모델로 바뀌던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed a running session silently switching to the organization's default model when another Claude Code process refreshed a stale model-access entry

items.ko: Pro·Team 에서 Fable 긴 컨텍스트 429 가 잘못된 안내를 띄우던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed long-context 429s on Fable models showing the usage-credits consent prompt instead of the 1M-context message on Pro and Team plans

items.ko: 프로필 기반 워크로드 아이덴티티 연동이 `401 jti reused` 로 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed workload identity federation via a profile (as claude-code-action configures it): processes sharing the profile could fail mid-run with `401 … jti reused`

items.ko: MCP 서버 OAuth 로그인이 콜백 포트 부족으로 실패하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed MCP server OAuth sign-in failing with "No available ports for OAuth redirect" when the local callback port range can't be bound

items.ko: `/compact` 요약이 `$` 가 든 텍스트를 깨뜨리던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the conversation summary produced by `/compact` and auto-compact mangling text that contained `$` sequences

items.ko: `/compact` 로 끝난 대화를 다시 열 때 복원 파일 메모 순서가 달라지던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed resuming a conversation that ended with `/compact`: its restored-file notes now load in the same order on every resume

items.ko: SDK 프롬프트 제안·`/rename` 이 압축 이전 대화를 보내던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed SDK prompt suggestions, side questions and `/rename` sending the conversation from before a compaction

items.ko: 위 화살표로 부른 프롬프트를 고칠 때 `@`·`/` 자동완성이 안 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `@` file and `/` command suggestions not appearing after recalling a previous prompt with the up arrow and editing it

items.ko: `claude agents` 에서 ← 를 빠르게 다시 눌러도 무시되던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude agents`: pressing ← again at a natural pace to go back to the agent list no longer gets ignored until you pause for over a second

items.ko: `claude agents` 세션 삭제가 워크트리 제거 실패로 멈추던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude agents` session delete getting stuck when a worktree can't be removed: the message names the cause and next step, and for a git worktree ctrl+x again deletes the directory anyway

items.ko: 에이전트 패널의 백그라운드 행이 줄바꿈 때문에 여러 줄로 늘어나던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed background agent and workflow rows in the agents panel expanding to many lines when their text contained line breaks

items.ko: 조직 MCP 허용 목록 설정 시 Slack 세션이 Slack 도구를 잃던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude in Slack sessions losing their Slack tools when org managed settings set an MCP allowlist

items.ko: Claude in Chrome 이 호스트를 못 읽어 `https` 허용을 묻던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome asking to allow the host "https" when a navigation URL had a scheme but a host that could not be parsed

items.ko: 작업 라벨이 길 때 스피너가 여러 줄로 감기던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the spinner wrapping onto several lines when the current task's label is long; the label and the "Next:" task line now stay within one terminal row

items.ko: 터미널 네이티브 커서 사용 시 `/bug`·`/feedback` 입력란에 커서가 안 보이던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed the `/bug` and `/feedback` description field showing no cursor when the terminal's native cursor is enabled

items.ko: Remote Control 세션이 `ListAgents` 에서 생성된 이름으로 뜨던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions served by `claude remote-control` showing a generated name instead of their session title in `ListAgents`

items.ko: `claude plugin validate` 가 점 두 개로 시작하는 디렉터리를 거부하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` rejecting plugin paths whose directory name begins with two dots, which the plugin loader accepts

items.ko: 플러그인이 확인 못 한 monitors 파일·루트 SKILL.md 를 건너뛰던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed plugins silently skipping a default monitors file or root SKILL.md that could not be checked

items.ko: localhost 등 점 없는 호스트에 대한 WebFetch 거부 사유 안내 개선
items.en: Fixed WebFetch's error for localhost and other dotless hostnames to explain why the URL is refused and suggest curl

items.ko: `--print` 모드에서 PermissionRequest 훅이 실행되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed PermissionRequest hooks not firing in `--print` mode

items.ko: 헤드리스(`-p`) 실행에서 정책 도우미 경고가 출력되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed policy-helper warnings not printing on headless (`-p`) runs

items.ko: `/resume` 가 `/fork` 세션을 부모 이름으로 표시하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/resume` listing a `/fork` background session under its parent's name instead of its own `⑂` fork name

items.ko: 로그아웃 상태에서 claude.ai 명령이 `/login` 대신 마이그레이션 안내를 띄우던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/remote-control` and other claude.ai-gated commands to suggest `/login` when signed out instead of showing a Claude for Enterprise migration message

items.ko: `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` 가 SessionEnd 훅에 적용되지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` not extending SessionEnd hooks that have no per-hook `timeout` (they were still cancelled after 1.5 seconds)

items.ko: GitHub 계정 미연결 시 `/autofix-pr` 등이 잘못된 재시도 안내를 하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed `/autofix-pr` and other cloud-session commands saying to retry or install the Claude GitHub App when no GitHub account is connected; they now point to `/web-setup` or the web connect page

items.ko: 조직 정책으로 꺼진 `/teleport` 등이 알 수 없는 명령이라고 답하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed cloud-session commands such as `/teleport` and `/remote-env` to explain when an organization policy turns them off, instead of answering "Unknown command"

items.ko: Bash 샌드박스 설명이 실제보다 강한 격리를 주장하던 문제 수정
items.en: Fixed Bash sandbox instructions over-stating confinement: no unenforced path lists when filesystem isolation is off, and strict mode no longer claims commands can never run unsandboxed

items.ko: 전체화면에서 프롬프트 줄 추가·삭제(Shift+Enter) 시 다시 그리는 속도 개선
items.en: Improved fullscreen mode: adding or removing a prompt line (Shift+Enter) now repaints as fast as typing a character instead of re-rendering the visible transcript

items.ko: `--continue`·`--resume` 이 SessionStart 훅을 기다리지 않고 바로 뜨도록 개선
items.en: Improved `--continue` / `--resume`: the conversation appears immediately instead of waiting for SessionStart hooks, and the first message no longer re-reads the whole transcript

items.ko: 도구 호출이 많은 턴에서 숨은 알림으로 트랜스크립트를 다시 그리지 않도록 개선
items.en: Improved responsiveness during tool-heavy turns by no longer redrawing the transcript for a hidden per-tool-batch reminder

items.ko: `.claude/workflows/` 스크립트가 있는 프로젝트의 시작 속도 개선
items.en: Improved startup time in projects with `.claude/workflows/` scripts: listing them no longer parses each script

items.ko: 자동 모드 거부 시 Claude 에게 차단한 규칙을 알려 주도록 메시지 개선
items.en: Improved auto mode denials: the message Claude receives now names the rule that blocked the action and asks Claude to try a safer method and finish unrelated work before stopping to ask you

items.ko: Claude in Chrome 에서 긴 페이지를 파일 대신 인라인으로 읽도록 개선
items.en: Improved Claude in Chrome: long page reads now stay inline instead of being saved to a file and read back

items.ko: MEMORY.md 잘림 경고에 잘린 줄 수와 시작 위치를 표시하도록 개선
items.en: Improved the MEMORY.md truncation warning to say how many lines were cut and where the cut starts

items.ko: 터미널 아티팩트 권한 프롬프트가 요청의 질문을 먼저 보여 주도록 개선
items.en: Improved the terminal permission prompt for artifacts: it now leads with the ask's question

items.ko: 에디터·`/diff` 선택 영역을 프롬프트 입력 안에 표시하도록 푸터 개선
items.en: Improved the prompt footer: an editor or `/diff` selection now shows inside the prompt input, and fullscreen mode shows Remote Control status in the header instead of the footer

items.ko: 1M 컨텍스트 사용 크레딧 안내에 재시작이 필요하다는 설명 추가
items.en: Improved the "Usage credits required for 1M context" message to say that usage credits turned on mid-session take effect after restarting Claude Code

items.ko: `/plugin` 의 설치·활성화 변경이 메뉴를 닫으면 바로 적용되도록 개선
items.en: Improved `/plugin`: installing, enabling or disabling a plugin now takes effect when you close the menu; `/reload-plugins` is no longer needed afterwards

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·Foundry 시스템 프롬프트를 첨부로 전달하도록 변경
items.en: Changed the system prompt on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to deliver environment, model and settings details as attachments, matching first-party sessions

items.ko: Bedrock·Vertex·Foundry 세션의 도구 목록을 대화 내내 고정하도록 변경
items.en: Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry sessions to keep the tool list byte-stable across a conversation (late-connecting tools load deferred instead of rewriting it), matching first-party sessions

items.ko: TodoWrite 등 작업 추적 도구를 구형 모델에서만 제공하도록 변경
items.en: Changed the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) to be offered only on Claude 3.x, Opus 4.0–4.7, Sonnet 4.0–4.6, Haiku 4.5; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` elsewhere

items.ko: 아티팩트 데이터 편집 권한 프롬프트를 문서 수와 공개 범위를 담은 카드로 변경
items.en: Changed the artifact data-edit permission prompt in the terminal to a card that shows the document count and who can open the artifact

items.ko: 승인 생략 Cowork 세션에서 Artifact 도구가 세션 폴더 밖 파일을 거부하도록 변경
items.en: Changed local Cowork sessions set to skip all approvals: the Artifact tool now refuses a local file outside the session's folders, or behind a symlink, instead of reading it without asking

items.ko: `WebFetch` deny·ask 규칙이 Artifact 도구에 적용되지 않도록 변경 — `Artifact` 규칙 사용
items.en: Changed plain `WebFetch` deny and ask rules to no longer apply to Artifact tool reads and updates; use an `Artifact` rule (or `WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)`) to block or gate them

items.ko: MCP 서버 인증 필요 알림을 매 실행이 아니라 서버당 한 번만 표시하도록 변경
items.en: Changed the "N MCP servers need authentication" startup notice to announce each server once instead of at every launch

items.ko: [VSCode] `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 설정 시 세션 목록·설정·탭이 동작하지 않던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the session list, settings toggles, and chat tabs when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in a settings file or the `environmentVariables` setting

items.ko: [VSCode] 로그인·로그아웃 뒤 모델 표시와 명령 메뉴가 잠시 비던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed the model pill, model picker and command menu going blank in open tabs for a few seconds after a login, logout or account switch

items.ko: [VSCode] 설정 재정의가 있을 때 모드 선택기에서 Auto 가 사라지던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed Auto disappearing from the mode picker in new-tab or just-reloaded conversations when a project or local setting overrides the model named in `~/.claude/settings.json`

items.ko: [VSCode] 창을 다시 불러오면 세션 이름이 마지막 프롬프트로 되돌아가던 문제 수정
items.en: [VSCode] Fixed session names reverting to the last prompt after a window reload when a SessionStart hook is configured
